_comment: Non-secret ssgpipe pipeline configuration. Copy to pipeline-settings.json (untracked) for local runs via --settings-path, or set these keys/labels in Azure App Configuration (see infra/ssgpipe/README.md). Values below are placeholders only. NO access keys, connection strings, or SAS tokens are ever placed in this file — ADLS Gen2 auth is Managed Identity only, resolved by ParquetPartitionSinkConnector itself (see src/pytiq/connectors/sink/parquet_partition_sink_connector.py). For the storage account/container setting NAMES themselves, see src/pytiq/connectors/sink/resources/adls_gen2_settings.example.json — this file covers the pipeline-level settings that file does not.
